text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I drop by the mall to<n>find her a
folding umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow... So this is a foldin'<n>umbrella?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't need one of these doodads! It<n>weighs a ton
and seems like a pain to<n>haul around!
choice_data_list: What if you get caught in the rain?
What if you get caught in the rain?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, like the other day? Well, if it<n>happens again,
then...
I'll just hop under your umbrella! No<n>problem!

Even if there ain't a lot of space, I<n>know just what
to do! I'll squeeze up<n>to ya real tight and squish my
way in!
choice_data_list: What if I'm not with you?
What if I'm not with you?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What?! You tellin' me you're not<n>gonna be by my
side, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gosh... I never thought of that! I just<n>figured you'd
always be around...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That'd be a real pickle! I'd best go<n>grab myself an
umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But there're so many! I'm not sure<n>which one to
pick...
Which do ya reckon I should buy,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list: A light umbrella that's easy to run with.
A sturdy umbrella that's sure to last.

text_block_list.text: Oh, this one'll suit me just fine! I can<n>tell!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it shouldn't weigh down<n>my bag. You
weren't lying when ya<n>said ya can run with it!
The following day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lemme borrow your<n>umbrella!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, ya see, it needs some<n>patchin' up. I ran
so fast it got blown<n>to bits.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before lending her my umbrella, I<n>warn her not to
run at full speed in the<n>rain.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But doesn't this one look a<n>smidge heavy?
Well, I'll give it a<n>spin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Scuse me! Can I test out this<n>heavy-lookin'
umbrella?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, this one's got some real<n>weight to it! Way
more than I<n>expected!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But color me surprised—it's growin'<n>on me! I could
use it as a barbell!
I'll take it! In fact, I'd like a hundred<n>of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It takes a lot of work to convince her<n>she doesn't
need that many<n>umbrellas...
